en.html:
Muramasa herself seemed a little drained.

This was not some holiday bungalow where we had come to recover our health. Middle of enemy territory—that was the more accurate address. From that angle, perhaps this much strain was getting off lightly. But whatever angle I chose, my eyelids were coming down only.

Apparently my body would not accept a well-reasoned argument in place of sleep.

ja.html:
そう言う村正も、心なしか気怠げだ。

　別荘地で療養しているのではない。敵地の真ん中に
いると考える方がむしろ事実に近いだろう。
　そう思えば、この程度の気苦労はまだしも軽いもの
なのかもしれないが――どう思おうと目蓋は下がる。

　理論武装で疲労を克服できるほど俺は器用に出来て
いないようだ。

en.html:
Nothing suspicious was there.

Furniture exactly where it had been in the morning. Somebody had cleaned, yes, but cleaning was allowed to mean cleaning. They must have done it while I was out.

Nothing suspicious.

The same room I remembered.
No sounds except ours.
A faint smell of plants and flowers.

不審に思うべき点は何も無い。

　調度の配置は朝と同じ。掃除をされた形跡はあるが、
それは無論それだけの事である。
　部屋を空けている間に誰かがやってくれたのだろう。

　不審な点は無い。

　記憶と変わらぬ部屋の様相。
　俺と村正が立てるのみの物音。
　ほのかに漂う草花の香り。

Black from head to foot. Most of the face covered too. But from his movements, young and well trained—those two things I could make out.

Kuronose"..."
Muramasa"Mido, look at the situation. This much we can understand without asking, no?"

Kageaki"What about the small possibility that the cleaning gentleman is very thorough in his duty—"
Muramasa"No. In what bloody twist of the story is THIS the cleaning gentleman?"

Kuronose"You lowborn dogs are making a tamasha of me...!"

Kuronose"..."

en.html:
Somehow I had lost all support. From the front and from behind, the same quality of anger was coming in the same quantity. Very balanced arrangement.

For now, I concentrated on the front. He was not heavily armed; that much was clear. The shape of his body under the black clothes left no room for a gun or a great sword.

Which did not make him any less dangerous. Inside a room, a small concealed weapon would be more useful. For him. For me, a problem.

If he had the skill and the will to kill, one slash could open my throat before I even saw its path. As yet I had no reason to think either requirement was lacking.

A fighting man, plainly.
And such a man, sneaking into the Kubo's headquarters—

ja.html:
どうしてか、俺は孤立してしまった気がした。
　正面と背後から同質同量の怒りが迫っているように
感じられてならない。

　とりあえず、正面に意識を集中する。
　一見して断定できるのは、重武装ではないという事
だ。銃砲も大剣も黒衣の下には潜ませてあるまい。体
の線から自明である。

　といって、危険性が些かでも揺らぐ事はないが。
　室内である点に思慮を致せば、隠し持てる程の小型
兵装の方が有用であり、つまり俺にとっては脅威。

　男に充分な業と殺意があれば、軌跡も見せぬ一閃で
俺の首を<ruby>掻<rt>か</rt></ruby>くだろう。
　そしてそのどちらかでも不足していると判断すべき
根拠は、今のところ皆無である。

　男はどう見ても武人。
　それが、侵入者として<ruby>公方府<rt>ここ</rt></ruby>にいるなら――

Kuronose"Now I will not beg to leave alive. You want my death? Fine. I shall make it bloom."
Kuronose"But I am taking company to the next world. That souvenir will cost you bastards!"
Kageaki"Pointless."
Kuronose"Pointless? A few of you Rokuhara dogs dead with me, and ordinary people can breathe a little easier!"
Kageaki"Again I am saying, pointless. If your enemy is Rokuhara, fighting us here achieves nothing."
Kuronose"...What?"
Kageaki"Please keep still. With such effort you stopped the bleeding; now the wound will open again."
Kageaki"From what I can tell, a deep wound. Your face also suggests you have lost a great deal of blood... If it starts again, your life will certainly be in danger."
Kageaki"And making a scene will bring people here. That also you do not want, no? So please think before you move."
Kuronose"............"
Kuronose"Who are you?"
Kageaki"............"

en.html:
Kuronose"You will not answer...?"
Kageaki"No, sorry. What the answer is, that took me a little time."
Kageaki"My name is Kageaki Minato. For certain reasons I am staying with the Kubo of Horigoe... A houseguest eating at her expense, you could say."
Kuronose"...A houseguest?"
Kageaki"For my position, no better word is coming."
Muramasa"...No, really. There isn't..."
Kuronose"Neither Rokuhara nor the Kubo of Horigoe—you serve neither?"
Kageaki"For food and shelter I am indebted to her. But master and retainer, that we are not."
Kuronose"..."
Kuronose"What do you intend to do with me?"
Kageaki"You are the person pursued after causing some disturbance here this morning."
Kuronose"..."
Kageaki"Made them think you had escaped, but stayed hidden inside until late at night...?"
Kuronose"..."
Kageaki"I see. Even outside the mansion, this is Horigoe's military district. More reliable than fleeing blindly."

en.html:
An honest answer I had not expected anyway.

Almost certainly an anti-shogunate revolutionary.
...Now what to do?

Making him my enemy served no purpose. My own mouth had already delivered this judgment. Joining his cause, however, was not my business either.

Neutrality should have been a very fine third choice. Unfortunately, somebody had removed it before I arrived. Keep him in the room: helping him. Throw him out: opposing him. Say 'I am neutral' very firmly while doing either: same result, but now with a fool's announcement attached.

My hosts were feeding and sheltering me. Helping a man who had entered their house with hostile intentions was a strange way of saying thank you. Excellent rice, Your Excellency; as a small token of appreciation, here is one revolutionary behind your shelf.

But without help, he would certainly be trapped. Then dead.

He hated the shogunate. Probably he had fought the Horigoe troops. Nothing suggested he had attacked noncombatants. Not one sign. I could not kick him out to die simply because my obligations had become inconvenient.

And suppose I sheltered him, and instead of escaping he used the opportunity to sabotage the headquarters? Even a small chance of that could not be pushed aside.

Then what? Stand among the damage saying, arre, I only helped the man hide, whatever he did after hiding is his personal hobby?

Nahi. A portion of that damage would be mine.

ja.html:
正直な答が返ってくるとは、最初から思っていない。

　十中八九、倒幕派の志士であろう。
　……どうするべきか。

　敵対するのは全く無益である。既に自分の口で言明
した通り。
　といって、加勢する筋ではない。

　中立の選択は――この状況に用意されていなかった。
　部屋に留めるなら味方、追い出すなら敵対であろう。
事実上の。

　寝食の義理を思えば、明白な非友好的意図を持って
侵入した者に幾らかでも手を貸すのは気が引ける。
　しかし現状況、俺が手を貸さねば彼の進退が窮まる
のは確実であり、その結果彼が死ぬのも確実である。

　彼は幕府に敵意を持ち、この堀越の将兵とも干戈を
交えたのだろうが、非戦闘員にまで刃を振るったわけ
ではない。
　そんな形跡は全く無かった。

　彼を死地へ蹴り出す気にはとてもなれない。
　だが、彼を匿った結果――機会を得た彼が逃亡する
代わり公方府に対する破壊行動へ踏み切るような事が、
万一にでもあったなら。

　そこで生じる被害に、俺の責任なしとは言えまい。
